mapper.sql: SELECT mnm_id, title, content, status, reg_user, reg_date, upd_date FROM tb_mnm
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_mnm (title, content, status, reg_user, reg_date, upd_date) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{status}, #{regUser}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_mnm SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, status = #{status}, upd_date = NOW() WHERE mnm_id = #{mnmId}
mapper.select: SELECT status AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM tb_mnm GROUP BY status
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(reg_date, '%m') AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM tb_mnm WHERE YEAR(reg_date) = #{year} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(reg_date, '%m') ORDER BY label
SELECT reg_user AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM tb_mnm GROUP BY reg_user ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('완료','COMPLETED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed FROM tb_mnm

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(reg_date, '%m') AS label, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, reg_date, upd_date)) AS value FROM tb_mnm WHERE status IN ('완료','COMPLETED') AND YEAR(reg_date) = #{year} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(reg_date, '%m') ORDER BY label
